SCI low-light assistance model

Original SCI implementation and checkpoint:
Copyright (c) 2022 Tengyu Ma
https://github.com/vis-opt-group/SCI
CVPR subtree at f6f88fd73cd614dbeee17d61a0dbde3678b7e183
MIT License: LICENSE-SCI.txt

ONNX inference-only conversion and packaged ONNX checkpoint:
Copyright (c) 2024 mdturp
https://github.com/mdturp/low-light-image-enhancement
Revision ea248be860bd4e0ab001f893cd96fb3119f82dac
MIT License: LICENSE-SCI-ONNX.txt

The port's difficult checkpoint is byte-identical to the original SCI
CVPR/weights/difficult.pt checkpoint. The unchanged packaged ONNX is
frontend/public/model.onnx from the pinned port revision; it has not been
quantized, retrained, or modified by Super Spedytor.

SCI reference:
Long Ma, Tengyu Ma, Risheng Liu, Xin Fan, Zhongxuan Luo.
Toward Fast, Flexible, and Robust Low-Light Image Enhancement. CVPR 2022.

Super Spedytor supplies a bounded Android CPU runner and applies conservative
gain fields to original image pixels. SCI supports low-light correction;
native document background correction handles document shadows separately.
The model does not identify document edges or reconstruct unreadable text.
